quotes.title: Kepler-438
quotes.card: Kepler-438 is a red dwarf in the constellation Lyra, about 590 light years from Earth.
quotes.introduction: It is notable for its planetary system, which includes Kepler-438b, a possibly Earth-size planet within Kepler-438's habitable zone.
